summary: Coos County, OR lookout site: a tower built in 1935 and abandoned in 1942. It is gone, and no source describes what remains there today.

facts.agency: Coos County Fire Patrol association (Coos County FPA)
facts.status_note: Abandoned in 1942 and gone; no source describes what remains at the site

events.note: A Coos County Fire Patrol association man went to the lookout (1930 newspaper item quoted by Forest Lookouts)
Planned: a Marshfield man was to take charge of the lookout for the summer (1931 newspaper item)
CCC crew to build a five-mile road to the lookout (1933 newspaper item)
Tower built on the site, per the register and firelookout.com
Abandoned; the site is now gone

tower built on the site in 1935

notes_for_editor: The record's conflict note 'They share a register number' could not be traced: only the register page gives a number (US 1807, OR 530), and the other two pages give none. The Forest Lookouts newspaper items (1930-1934) describe a lookout before the 1935 build date, and the 1934 item says a tower was still to be built; the sources do not explain what stood there earlier. Access is unknown and no source describes the site today, so the story gives no visit advice. The 1930 item says Eden Ridge; a separate Eden Ridge lookout station built in 1940 (Siskiyou NF, Forest Lookouts) is a different record and is not used here.
